key_impacts: Over 13 lakh people evacuated before landfall
18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected
Subsequent floods caused 23 more deaths in Odisha and 1 in Andhra Pradesh
Road closures; helicopters and alternate transport used for rescues
evidence_snippets: On 12 October 2013, Cyclone Phailin crossed the coastline south of Brahmapur, Odisha.
In total there were 18 districts in Odisha and 3 districts in Andhra Pradesh affected by the cyclone.
There was significant flooding in Jharkhand, Bihar and Chhattisgarh.
